en: A sepia-toned postcard featuring a large, ornate, multi-story historic building with a pointed turret on the corner. There are many horse-drawn carriages and people in period dress gathered in a bustling square in front of the building. Text appears in both printed and cursive hand at the bottom and left margin. The overall scene suggests a European city in the late 19th or early 20th century.
